command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
test "$(hostname)" = "ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein"
EXPECTED_DAEMON="0ab232f7112b046ced7e3e4ae454fe0d800eebd32d23bdac138c961bc069dff9"
EXPECTED_HTML="87cc0e3a94781f90a7533b129743597753876a8410b868767d243b753c5d3645"
BACKUP="buehne_daemon.py.go-gpu-backup-20260912T0708"
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum "$BACKUP" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('buehne_daemon.py')
s=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
old='''             "--disable-gpu",
             "--disable-gpu-compositing",
             "--disable-software-rasterizer"],'''
new='''],'''
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'exact GPU flag block count={s.count(old)} expected=1')
s2=s.replace(old,new,1)
for tok in ('--disable-gpu','--disable-gpu-compositing','--disable-software-rasterizer'):
    if tok in s2:
        raise SystemExit(f'GPU-disable token remains in source: {tok}')
p.write_text(s2,encoding='utf-8')
PY
python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py
NEW_SHA="$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "OLD_SHA=$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
echo "NEW_SHA=$NEW_SHA"
systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service
sleep 12
if test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" != "active"; then
  cp -a "$BACKUP" buehne_daemon.py; python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py; systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service; exit 51
fi
if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/ >/dev/null; then
  cp -a "$BACKUP" buehne_daemon.py; python3 -m py_compile buehne_daemon.py; systemctl --user restart frankenstein-buehne.service; exit 52
fi
echo '=== CHROME ARGV ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
live=[]; bad=[]
flags=('--disable-gpu','--disable-gpu-compositing','--disable-software-rasterizer')
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
    try:
        argv=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in (p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if x]
    except Exception:
        continue
    if not argv or argv[0] != '/opt/google/chrome/chrome':
        continue
    cmd=' '.join(argv)
    if '--app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' in argv or '--user-data-dir=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/chrome-profile' in argv:
        live.append((p.name,cmd))
        if any(f in argv for f in flags): bad.append((p.name,cmd))
for pid,cmd in live:
    print(pid,cmd)
print('LIVE_CHROME_COUNT',len(live))
print('BAD_FLAG_PROCESS_COUNT',len(bad))
if not live: raise SystemExit('no exact live Chrome process found')
if bad: raise SystemExit('disable GPU flag still present on exact Chrome argv')
PY
echo '=== FPS SAMPLES ==='
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  date +%H:%M:%S
  curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(d.get("fps"),ensure_ascii=False))'
  sleep 3
done
echo '=== CPU SNAPSHOT ==='
ps -eo pid,pcpu,rss,args | awk '$4 ~ /python3/ || $4 ~ /chrome/ {print}' | grep -E 'buehne_daemon.py|chrome-profile' | head -20 || true
echo '=== FINAL HASHES ==='
sha256sum buehne_daemon.py buehne.html filmlook.js
